lines.en: Hello. It is raining. Can I borrow an umbrella?
lines.ko: 안녕하세요. 비가 오네요. 우산 좀 빌릴 수 있을까요?

lines.en: Sure. Here, take this one.
Thank you so much. I will give it back tomorrow.
Keep it. I have two.
lines.ko: 그냥 가지세요. 저는 두 개 있어요.

lines.en: Really? You are so kind.
I lost one last month, so I got two.
lines.ko: 지난달에 하나를 잃어버려서 두 개 샀어요.

lines.en: I see. Did you receive my cake yesterday?
Yes, I did. My children love it.
I'm happy. I will send more next week.
Thank you. Show me how to make it some day.
lines.ko: 고마워요. 언젠가 만드는 법을 보여 주세요.

lines.en: Mom, I want to give you a gift.
For me? What is it?
Open it. I got it in a shop yesterday.
A warm hat! Thank you. I love it.
lines.ko: 따뜻한 모자네요! 고마워요. 정말 마음에 들어요.

lines.en: Do you remember? You lost your hat last winter.
Yes. I looked for it for days last winter.
Now keep this one safe. Do you like the color?
lines.ko: 이건 잘 간직하세요. 색은 마음에 들어요?

lines.en: Yes, I do. I will wear it every day.
Show it to Dad. He will receive one too.
lines.ko: 아빠에게도 보여 주세요. 아빠도 하나 받으실 거예요.

lines.en: I will. Thank you. You are so kind.
